statement: The efficacy tables analyze the efficacy population, the subjects with ADSL.EFFFL = Y, each in the column of the planned treatment ADSL.TRT01PN (0, 54, 81).

citations.quote: All patients who were randomized and took drug, and have at least 1 post-baseline measure
using randomized treatment as class variable

statement: The value of a subject at a week is the ADQSADAS record of the parameter ACTOT with that AVISIT and ANL01FL = Y: the assessment of the window that is closest to its target day, or, when the window has none, the last one carried forward (DTYPE = LOCF).

citations.quote: Missing postbaseline efficacy values will be imputed using last observation carried forward
the assessment closest to the target day will be selected

statement: The ANCOVA of the change from baseline has the treatment and the pooled site group (SITEGR1) as factors and the baseline value (BASE) as a covariate, with no interaction.

citations.quote: an ANCOVA model will be used with the baseline score, site, and treatment
a new pooled site identifier assigned for the purpose of analysis
site group as class variable in model and the baseline value as a covariate

statement: The test of dose response is the test that the coefficient of the planned dose (0, 54, 81), a continuous variable in the ANCOVA, is 0.

citations.quote: H0: b = 0, where b is the coefficient for treatment
Treatment will be included as a continuous variable
randomized dose (0 for placebo; 54 for low dose; 81 for high dose)

statement: The pairwise comparisons are differences of LS means of the ANCOVA with the treatment as a factor: each dose against placebo and the high dose against the low dose, with the residual degrees of freedom, 95% confidence intervals and p-values not adjusted for multiple comparisons.

citations.quote: pairwise comparisons among the 3 groups will be performed
p-values without adjustment for multiple comparisons
lsmeans trtpn / OM STDERR PDIFF CL

statement: LS means average over the pooled site groups with weights proportional to their numbers of model records (the observed margins).

citations.quote: lsmeans trtpn / OM STDERR PDIFF CL

statement: The rows Baseline summarize BASE on the records of the week of the table, so that Baseline, the week and the change describe the same subjects.

Numbers are shown with the decimals of SAP template 5: n 0, mean 1, SD 2, median 1, minimum and maximum 0, p-values 3, differences of LS means 1, their SE 2, the limits of their 95% CI 2; rounded half away from zero.
